title: 農村有線廣播 (Rural Wired Broadcasting)
notes: 1976 PRC science-education film, Mandarin narration, a colour print faded to magenta: how the county broadcast reaches the village by wire — the line over the fields, a commune meeting, the county station's amplifier racks, the 縣廣播站 diagram of wires fanning out to the communes, a lineman raising poles, a woman fixing the loudspeaker box to a wall, and a crowd gathered under it listening.
